125168: Our main character is the quiet and sensitive gray wolf Legoshi. Because of his fearsome appearance and odd habits he is widely mistaken to be a scary, bloodthirsty carnivore.
125169: Haru is the lone member of Cherryton School's gardening club. She is earnest and forthright which, in addition to her sexual promiscuity, has earned her a sleazy reputation. Haru is broadly confident, but a defeatist side sometimes peeks through her facade.
125170: The proud face of Cherryton's drama club. He has an enormous ego, but with acting skills like his this isn't surprising. He carries a number of personality complexes owing to his status as a deer, a species traditionally seen as carnivore fodder.
132945: Bengal Tiger who is a student and member of the Drama Club at Cherryton Academy.
132946: Juno is one of the five main characters of Beastars and is a member of the drama club on the actor team. A feminine, affable wolf, she wishes to become the next Beastar, competing against Louis.
132947: Pina is a recurring character in Beastars. He appeared as a first-year student and a new actor in the drama club at Cherryton Academy.
132948: A back alley psychiatrist who tries to rehabilitate carnivorous animals that crave meat. The wounds on his face were made by violent patients. Despite his gruff appearance and rough character, he's gentle and caring.
132982: Both one of Legoshi's roommates and his best friend for many years, Jack is a rather average guy. He is often weirded out by Legoshi's behavior, especially involving Haru, but he is always there for his best friend.
132983: Riz is a kindhearted and quiet Bear in the drama club who is loved and respected by his classmates. He prefers to draw little attention to himself by mostly standing in the background.
132985: Ibuki is a Maasai lion in his mid-thirties with an athletic build. He has light golden-yellow fur, light brown mane, and sharp, slanted eyes with small black pupils. Ibuki has tattoos on the left side of his body from his time as a child going to be used for making hyperdrugs.
151287: She is a minor antagonist in Beastars and a student at Cherryton Academy.
159863: Kai is a small, brown-furred mongoose with a slender build and face. His features are small but expressive. Kai is eager, brash and desperate to prove himself. Driven to a fault, he’s shown to be somewhat selfish.
160347: English sheepdog who is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. He has a calm and friendly personality and is often seen offering rides to their smallest group member, Voss.
160348: Coyote who is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. He likes to sumo/arm wrestle against Legoshi and Collot, although he hasn't been able to beat either of them.
160350: She is a side character in Beastars. She work as the lead choreographer in the drama club at Cherryton Academy. In the manga, Shelia is a cheetah, while in the anime, she is a leopard.
160353: Fennec fox with a slender build and a very small body. He is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. His dormmate Collot is often seen giving him rides due to his small size
160356: Spotted hyena who is part of the canine room 701 with Legoshi. He plays electric guitar with a vulture in a band called "The Leftovers".
160358: Dom attends Cherryton academy and is a member of the dram club with Legoshi.
175767: Siberian Tiger who is the Headmaster of Cherryton Academy.
194483: Indian Lion who is an active member of the Shishigumi.
204637: Rokume is a minor character in Beastars. She is the one and only security guard of Cherryton Academy. Rokume has a very hesitant demeanor and, because she is always hidden, she does not usually socialize with anyone at all.
210163: Peach is a young sheep of short stature and slender physique. Like all sheep she has a wool that covers her entire body except for her face. She has small black eyes and long eyelashes.
